basic_info.description: Residence 31D at The Harrison is a statement of refined luxury and timeless design. Crafted by renowned designer Ken Fulk, this home embodies elegance and modern sophistication. Floor-to-ceiling windows showcase sweeping, unobstructed views of the Bay Bridge, capturing radiant sunrises and glowing evening vistas. The open two-bedroom, two-bath layout is filled with natural light and appointed with wide-plank oak floors, polished Carrara marble counters, StudioBecker cabinetry, Sub-Zero refrigeration, and a Bertazzoni range with Waterworks brass fixtures. Both bedrooms feature dazzling Bridge and water views, creating an atmosphere of serenity and escape. Residents enjoy five-star amenities including a 24-hour concierge, heated pool, hot tub, yoga studio, state-of-the-art fitness center, and the 49th-floor Harry's Club with panoramic vistas. One valet parking space and wine storage complete this exceptional offering. Located in vibrant South Beach, steps from the Ferry Building, world-class dining, and scenic waterfront paths, this residence offers the best of San Francisco luxury living.
